This reference line tells us, for example, the first radius; it is the radius from the center of our rectangle to the starting position of our rectangle. The smaller this number is, the more the starting position of our rectangle is. The next one is the length. The length is the length of the side of our rectangle. The inner side and the outer side are relative, so if we change one of the numbers, the other number will be modified in conjunction. Diameter is the diameter of each circle of our spiral board. It should be noted that the diameter cannot be smaller than the width of the side edge; otherwise, our board will cross. If the board is crossed, the board will not be able to be created. Finally, the direction can be set to a clockwise or counterclockwise direction. This is based on the position of our seal.
